## Summary

General TFWR scripts aimed at optimization/leaderboard work.

The repository covers:

- Hay, Wood, Carrot and Pumpkin harvesting
- Dinosaur/Bone harvesting
- Cactus sorting
- Maze/Gold harvesting
- Power/Sunflower harvesting
- orchestration, utilities and simulation helpers
